independent_deterministic_review.scope: Independent deterministic reconstruction of the visible combinatorial generator logic only; not model/runtime/training evidence.

swarm_findings.finding: The frozen holdout changes both template family and symbol pool relative to training. A holdout failure cannot identify whether unseen-template transfer, unseen-symbol transfer, or their interaction failed.

v2.1 explicitly asserts train_syms == val_syms, while the Trigger-2 checkpoint/split hardening requires immutable mutually disjoint TRAIN_ATOMS, VALIDATION_ATOMS, HOLDOUT_ATOMS and a final reserve after checkpoint-local atom admission. This research-level policy tension must be preregistered rather than silently averaged.
Zero marginal MI for the audited nuisance axes is a strong anti-shortcut property, but it does not separate the two held-out generalization factors when both change together.

repair_design.principle: Orthogonalize semantic/template generalization from symbol-identity generalization before final joint acceptance.
repair_design.selection_rule: Use calibration/validation cells only for model/mixture selection; keep the joint unseen-template+unseen-symbol cell sealed until all choices are frozen.
repair_design.atom_rule: Exact pool sizes remain conditional on checkpoint-local atom admission. Do not reuse the gabliterated snapshot's hidden-state ABI as selected-checkpoint fact.
repair_design.diagnostic_rule: Report all four cells separately; do not compress them into one average that can hide a template-only or symbol-only failure.

training_example_implication.stage_A_binding_isolation: Keep the fully factorial S3/codebook-order/layout/polarity curriculum.
training_example_implication.stage_B_architecture_grounding: Apply the same mapping operator to Xeno/HCU protocol semantics only after Stage A is diagnostically separable.
training_example_implication.hard_negative: A model that succeeds on seen symbols but fails unseen symbols has not demonstrated symbol-identity-invariant binding; a model that succeeds on seen templates but fails unseen templates has not demonstrated context-invariant binding.
training_example_implication.retention: Preserve semantic-read, symbol-write and carrier-binding functions already measured at the donor snapshot; re-establish them at the selected checkpoint before positive ABI/J-Space credit.

next_exact_action: Revise the retained Trigger-2 blueprint/split manifest so unseen-template and unseen-symbol transfer are measured as separate preregistered factors plus a final sealed joint cell; then rerun the existing factorial MI/leak checks and current cross-split guard before any dataset admission.
